item.title: I don't know how you get here from "predict the next word."
item.description:
📝 I didn’t really stress the causal interpretation of the valuation equation issue — does the valuation equation express how inflation causes surpluses or how surpluses cause inflation. 5 emphasize that discount rates and interest costs are central to the present value of surpluses (the denominator). A rise in real rates that compresses bond prices also generically lowers the present value of surpluses via discounting or raises interest costs.
🔗 Read more: https://www.grumpy-economist.com/p/refine
